_comment: Single source of truth for the SubagentStop evaluator AND the generated 'Your bead contract' block in the agent definition (compile-time). Do not hand-edit the generated block. Lifecycle phases (reported/in_review/approved/...) are NOT bd statuses and are never stored as labels; a reader derives them from status, assignee, the agent:reviewer label, gates, and the REPORTED/REVIEW comments. A specialist never CLOSES its own node, so `closed` is the forbidden built-in status. ROUTING: the architect is the one role that MAY write metadata.role, because it decomposes its epic and routes each node. deny_metadata cannot express that, being a presence test on the claimed bead rather than an authorship test. G5 grants it at the write seam (ROUTING_WRITERS in src/gates/claim.ts). The `handoff` check stays on the `agent:reviewer` LABEL, which is a ready-for-review signal and routes nothing now that metadata.role is authoritative. ORIGIN: the architect runs in an isolated clone that is deleted when it yields or parks, so origin is the only durable copy of the feature branch. It pushes the branch at creation and after every integration, stamps head_sha with the pushed commit, and releases the epic last. The exit gate asks origin with `git ls-remote` and refuses a yield or a park unless refs/heads/<metadata.branch> is at head_sha and the epic is released; an origin that does not answer refuses too. A replacement architect claims the released epic and resumes from origin.

completion.recovery: push the feature branch (`git push origin <branch>`) and stamp head_sha with the pushed commit, then release the epic (`bd update <epic> --claim --assignee ""`); the clone is deleted at yield and origin is the only copy
release the epic last, once the feature head is on origin: `bd update <epic> --claim --assignee ""`; an isolated architect cannot be revived, so a held epic strands the feature

escape.require: comment.verb in [FAILED, BLOCKED, ASK] and assignee cleared and origin.branch == head_sha and clone.work on origin.branch
escape.recovery: a park has two steps after the BLOCKED or ASK comment: push the feature branch and stamp head_sha with the pushed commit, then release the epic (`bd update <epic> --claim --assignee ""`) so a fresh architect can claim it; the clone is deleted at yield. An open escalation does not pause an architect: it parks this way, and the run's next architect resumes from origin
